title: Chapter 61
text:
Feng Jun rushed over with a group of fully armed field agents. As soon as he saw Han Xiao, he hurriedly patted him up and down to see if there were any wounds. "Are you hurt?"

Han Xiao pointed at the scratches on his face and said, "Are you blind?"

"That's good." Feng Jun heaved a sigh of relief. He felt his face burn as the person he had been protecting for twenty-four hours was injured.

"It's not your fault." Han Xiao did not blame him. He pointed at Norsa's body and said, "This guy is the executive officer of the Germinal Organization. He's a super assassin who has never failed."

"Norsa Kono?"

Feng Jun recognized him immediately. There was once a high-ranking official in Stardragon who had died under Norsa's gun in front of everyone. Norsa had always been the Germinal Organization's right-hand man and had never failed. He was like a deadly viper that the Six Nations were very wary of.

Feng Jun suddenly realized what was going on, and he stared at Han Xiao in disbelief. "Wait a minute, you were ambushed by Norsa, and you even killed him! You're that strong? "

"Is this your first day knowing me?"

Han Xiao said in annoyance.

He looked at the interface and the reward information appeared.

Character Summon Card: Release the ability of this character once.

Character: Norsa Kono

Ability: Illusion (E) – Target with INT above 50 will be immune to this ability.

Usage: 0/1

Character Summon Card was a rare consumable item that could only be obtained from special missions. It could only be used to limit the abilities of the NPC character. In the past, there was a special workshop that provided these cards to tycoons who liked to throw money at others. Although Han Xiao did not rely on these things in battle, who would not like to have an extra trump card?

Han Xiao was glad that he had added his Free Attribute Points to Intelligence early on and was immune to Norsa's ability. If he had only remembered to add his Free Attribute Points after being hit, he would have been in trouble.

"Germinal Organization, I'll accept this gift." Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

Since they were enemies, no matter how the enemy dealt with him, it was normal. He would not complain or be angry. What he had to do was to curb violence with violence.

Do you wish to receive the reward?

"No."

This kind of illusory consumable item could be stored in the interface and could be retrieved when needed.

Mad Blade's Angry Sword was ignored. He sized up the group of agents in black in shock and kept throwing out detectors. When he saw that they were field agents from Stardragon's Homeland Strategic Defense Department, he felt that Han Xiao was even more unfathomable.

Feng Jun pointed at Mad Blade's Furious Sword and asked, "Are you familiar with this person?"

"Ignore him."

Han Xiao took the handkerchief from Feng Jun and wiped the wound on his cheek. He frowned and said, "Norsa found my location, which means the Germinal Organization knows as well."

"That's not necessarily the case. The hackers of the intelligence department have blocked the network and conducted a program of screening and manual identification. Any news that mentions you are not allowed to leave the Western Capital."

Han Xiao's expression turned serious. "Are you sure?"

Feng Jun nodded and said hesitantly, "Norsa wouldn't act on his own accord. He must have given the information to the spies in the Western Capital. Sooner or later, the information will be leaked out."

Han Xiao heard this and turned to leave without another word.

"Hey, where are you going? I still have to take you to the headquarters to report," Feng Jun hurriedly shouted.

"There's no time to explain. Go and ask the higher-ups to block the entire city!"

However, Norsa had never failed before. He would not be too cautious and would probably act as soon as he found him. Norsa's information came from the Germinal Organization's spies in the Western Capital. Since the network was blocked, the spies could only leave the city.

Han Xiao knew the identity of the Germinal Organization's contact person in the Western Capital.

He had not dealt with the contact person because there was no need to. If he killed one, the Germinal Organization would send another one. It was more effective to leave a familiar nail and remove it at a critical moment.

If he killed Norsa, the Germinal Organization would be able to confirm that Han Xiao was in the Western Capital. However, if he could intercept the information, it would be able to delay the Germinal Organization's confirmation of his exact location.

Although this was only his guess and the information might have already left the city, even if there was only a slight possibility, it was worth a try. This had always been his principle.

"Li Ya Lin, immediately inform the others to find me in District 8. These are my coordinates. Remember to drive over!"

Li Ya Lin was confused. "Are you going to treat us? It's too insincere to go to the slums."

"Don't ask so many questions. Just go!"

Han Xiao hung up the phone and elbowed the window of a car on the side of the road. He then jumped into the car.

It was a race against time. It was time to stop bothering with trifles.

The owner of the car was talking on the phone beside the car. He was shocked by the sound of the window shattering. He quickly ran over and grabbed Han Xiao's collar. "Get out here!"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He pulled the driver's upper body into the car and pressed the driver's head against the steering wheel, making an ear-piercing honk sound.

"Great, I don't have to pull the cord to start the car."

Han Xiao pressed down on the struggling owner and found the keys. He successfully started the car, pushed the owner away, and stepped on the gas pedal to the floor.

The owner of the car sat on the ground. His face was printed with the lines of the steering wheel. He looked confused. "What the f * ck, are car thieves so crazy nowadays?"

…

He drove the car recklessly in the city. Everywhere he passed, the cars would quickly avoid him. Soon, he had passed several blocks. At this time, the siren sounded. A traffic police motorcycle followed him. The traffic police shouted, "The car in front, pull over immediately for inspection!"

Han Xiao took out the owner's license and threw it out.

"Take it and deduct points. Deduct as much as you want!"

Ignoring the traffic police, Han Xiao arrived at District 8, got out of the car, and ran toward the destination. The traffic police followed him on their motorcycles and blocked his path. "Stop right there!" Han Xiao shouted.

Han Xiao was furious. Why did everyone want to talk to you when you were in a hurry?

He chopped with his hand. The traffic police did not expect to be attacked. He rolled his eyes and fainted.

Han Xiao took big strides and turned through the complicated alleys. He knocked down three groups of robbers and came to an abandoned church. This was the residence of the poor. Many homeless people slept on the floor and spent the night with fleas, mud, and sweat.

Aquamarine also had the existence of religion. During the Old Era, during the war period, many displaced people were searching for spiritual sustenance. This religion took advantage of the opportunity and added the most popular idea during the war period, 'I hope for world peace', to their teachings. Thus, the number of followers reached tens of millions.

Then, the holy land of this religion was really destroyed.

The true god they believed in, "God of Heaven", did not come out to save them. Therefore, this religion gradually died out.

Rushing into the church, the homeless people looked at him with sleepy eyes.

Han Xiao looked around and did not find his target. He narrowed his eyes and grabbed a homeless man beside him. "Let me ask you, where did the man who lived here for a long time go? He has a red wolf tattoo on the back of his hand, and he's about 1.8 meters tall. He's about 40 years old. Where did he go?"

Seeing Han Xiao covered in blood, the homeless man trembled and said carefully, "Are you talking about Lu Gao En? We call him 'Tongueless'. He almost never speaks. He disappeared this afternoon. "

Afternoon?

Ordinary citizens had to go through a series of checkpoints to leave the West Capital. It was now two in the afternoon, so there might be a chance to stop him.

There were three checkpoints in the West Capital. Which one would Lu Gao En go to?

Han Xiao frowned. He did not expect Division 13 to seal off the West Capital in time. Regardless of whether the higher-ups agreed to it or not, even if they did, who knew how long it would take? Lu Gao En might have escaped long ago.

PS: Thank you Xi Yan for the reward!
